verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents only a Snyk integration for automatic security scans and mentions third-party code reports in PRs, but there's no evidence of native secret scanning, SAST, or DAST consolidated within Bitbucket itself — it relies on external providers rather than a unified in-platform scanning suite. missing for 10: native secret detection, native SAST/dependency scanning, dynamic (DAST) scanning, single-pane consolidated security dashboard beyond a Security tab plugin install.
